arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_positive_amount_usd FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 0
arguments.explanation: Returns the average dollar amount across all transactions whose amount is greater than zero.
assumptions: Covers all transactions in the period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, including those without a fraud label, since the question does not mention fraud.
Positive means amount_usd_cents > 0; zero-amount rows are excluded.
Result is converted from cents to dollars by dividing by 100.0.
